name: Attack (Action)
desc: With the Attack action you make one melee or ranged attack. Certain features — such as the fighter's Extra Attack — let a single Attack action make more than one attack. You resolve each attack by rolling a d20, adding the relevant modifiers, and comparing the total to the target's Armor Class.
